de.text: These terms apply to everyone who sells products („Creators“) on solid-sound.net („Solid Sound“, „we“). By applying to sell, you accept them together with our
1. What you can sell
DAW templates, presets, sample packs, MIDI, stems and music that you created or have the right to sell.
No third-party samples, loops or presets unless their licence allows redistribution. If in doubt, leave them out.
Every product needs a cover image, an MP3 preview and the correct details (format, genre, BPM, key and so on) so buyers can find it with our filters.
We review applications within 24 hours on business days.
New products are checked before they go live. We may ask you to fix details, or decline a product that breaks these terms.
Selling here is non-exclusive. You may sell the same products anywhere else.
You set the price. Prices are set in euros (EUR); buyers may see them converted into their local currency.

We may change rates for future sales with 30 days‘ notice by email. Rates for sales already made never change.

Your earnings are recorded in your Creator dashboard. Payouts will start once our payment setup for Creators is live. Before the first payout we will email you the payout method, schedule and minimum amount (planned: monthly, from €25).
Earnings from an order become available after the refund period has passed.
Fees charged by the payout provider may be deducted.
You are responsible for your own taxes on your earnings.

You give Solid Sound a non-exclusive licence to host, preview, promote (including on our social media, with your name) and sell your products.
Buyers receive a royalty-free licence to use the product in their own music, as described on our
. They may not resell or share the files themselves.
Refunds follow our store refund policy. Refunded sales are removed from your balance.
If a product is reported for copyright infringement, we may remove it while we investigate.

You may stop selling at any time by removing your products or contacting us. Your remaining balance above the payout minimum will be paid out.
